summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests gemcitabine, docetaxel, and toripalimab given before chemoradiation for locoregionally advanced EBV-positive nasopharyngeal carcinoma. Toripalimab is given by IV every 3 weeks with 3 induction cycles of gemcitabine and docetaxel, then radiation (70 Gy) with weekly cisplatin, then capecitabine by mouth twice daily for 12 months, with toripalimab for up to 9 adjuvant doses. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it describes the study as a safety, feasibility and efficacy study.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 evalúa gemcitabina, docetaxel y toripalimab administrados antes de la quimiorradioterapia para el carcinoma nasofaríngeo localmente avanzado asociado al EBV. El toripalimab se administra por vía intravenosa cada 3 semanas junto con 3 ciclos de inducción de gemcitabina y docetaxel, luego radiación (70 Gy) con cisplatino semanal, y después capecitabina por vía oral dos veces al día durante 12 meses, con hasta 9 dosis adyuvantes de toripalimab. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; describe el estudio como un estudio de seguridad, factibilidad y eficacia.
who_for: Locoregionally advanced EBV-positive nasopharyngeal carcinoma (T3-4 with any N, or any T with N1-3, and no distant spread)
No prior treatment for nasopharyngeal carcinoma is allowed
Adequate blood counts, liver function and kidney function
not_for: Prior systemic anticancer treatment for nasopharyngeal carcinoma
Prior radiation to the head and neck region that requires overlapping fields
Concurrent use of other anticancer treatment
Autoimmune disease or organ transplant that the investigator judges would raise risk from immune checkpoint inhibition
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or severe active comorbidity or AIDS
